question: Which parts of the Vāstunara must not be pressed during wall construction and similar activities?
premises: The time of mounting walls and similar structures is specified.
The head and other body parts of the Vāstunara are mapped on the site.
inference: During wall construction and similar activities, one must not press upon the head and other parts of the Vāstunara.
plain_english: At the time of raising walls and the like, one should not press upon his head and other parts.
